utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — what time should I swing by?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Anytime after 3 should be fine. I’ll be here.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, I’ll come by after 3.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I need the drop-off time and exact address first—otherwise I might miss the window.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, can you confirm the drop-off time and the exact address for me?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I don’t have the time or address yet, so I can’t confirm it. Once you send both, I’ll check my schedule and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, the repair drive—sorry, I must’ve missed the details. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: No worries, I’m a bit scattered too. If you could just show up Saturday and bring a screwdriver, that’d be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure thing, I’ll be there Saturday with a screwdriver. Thanks for the reminder!

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll mention the repair drive to a few neighbors and keep spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Vik — that would really help. I’ll keep an eye out for anyone who wants to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll bring it up around the block and see who’s interested. We can get a few more hands for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m late again, but I can still help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Bring whatever tools you’ve got handy—hammer, screwdriver, and maybe a wrench set if you have one.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’ve got a hammer and screwdriver for sure, and I’ll check for the wrench set before I head over.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good—what time is the repair drive, and what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: It starts at 10 Saturday morning by the community center—just bring any tools you’re willing to lend and maybe a pair of gloves.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Got it—I'll be there at 10 with a few tools and gloves. See you at the community center on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did the repair drive get a date yet, or are we still figuring that out?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: We’re still figuring it out, but I’m happy to help pin down a date if you want.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yeah, I do want to pin it down—what dates are we looking at?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yeah, I’m in for the repair drive — happy to help where I can. Let me know what you need from me.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Jules — could you help collect the broken lamps from the community shed and bring them to my porch by 5?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll head over to the community shed and bring the broken lamps to your porch by 5.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can help with the repair drive—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh wonderful, Mara — thank you! We still need someone to sort the tool sign-out list and another person to check in with the neighbors who already volunteered.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can take the tool sign-out list and I’ll check in with the volunteers too. Just send me the names and I’ll get started.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check what supplies we’ve got on hand and see what we still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Cleo — just let me know what we’re short on and I’ll help.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll do a quick inventory and get back to you with the gaps. If you’ve got a minute later, I may ask you to help gather the missing items.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a good turnout already—folks are pitching in with tools, supplies, and a few volunteer hands. If you’ve got anything to add, I’m happy to pass it along!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’s good to hear. I don’t have anything to add right now, but I’m glad people are showing up.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s great to hear—every bit helps, and I’ll keep spreading the word as it comes in.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me of the repair drive details, like when it is and what needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sure — I’m checking the final schedule now, but it’s set for this Saturday morning at the community center. We’re mainly looking for help with small home repairs like leaky faucets, loose cabinets, and broken shelves.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, that helps. Do you know what time on Saturday morning it starts?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I can help out—just give me the quick version of what’s needed and when.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Bo—it's mostly a repair drive for folks who need a hand with basic fixes, and we’re gathering supplies this week. If you can spare time or tools, that’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it—what supplies do you need most, and when should I drop them off?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and remind folks it’s coming up.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Vik — I really appreciate you helping get the word out. That’ll make a big difference for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Of course — I’ll mention it around the neighborhood and make sure folks know the details.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. I must’ve missed the details, but I’m glad it’s happening.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, it should help a few people out. I’ll keep you posted when I know more.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Uli — I’d appreciate that. Just let me know if you need any help.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I heard about the repair drive. What do you need a hand with?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Mostly I could use a drill and a ladder, if you’ve got either to spare.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can lend you the drill, and I might be able to track down a ladder too. Want me to bring the drill by?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ve got the repair drive organized, and I’m happy to help however I can. What do you need me to handle first?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Could you start by checking which homes still need appliance repairs, then let me know the addresses?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ll check on that and pull together the addresses for any homes still needing appliance repairs. I’ll get back to you as soon as I have the list.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I need the exact drop-off time and where we’re meeting so I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — we’re meeting at the community center parking lot at 10:00 AM, and drop-offs can be brought there until noon. Let me know if you need the address again!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That works for me—can you send the address again just to be safe?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So, just to confirm, the repair drive is still happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, it’s still happening — let me just double-check the details before I say anything final.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — just let me know once you’ve confirmed the details.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good—what time are we heading over, and what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’ll probably swing by a little late, around 6:30. If you can bring a screwdriver and maybe some gloves, that’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: 6:30 works for me. I’ll bring the screwdriver and gloves and be ready when you swing by.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard the repair drive's getting organized—what do we still need help with?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We still need a few tools and some spare nails, plus anyone who can help sort donations.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it—I can spread the word about tools and nails, and I’ll see if anyone’s free to help sort donations too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I was meaning to ask if you still need any tools or extra hands.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’d be great, Oren—extra hands would really help. If you’ve got a drill or a wrench set, bring those too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing — I can bring a drill and my wrench set, and I’ll lend a hand too. Just tell me when to show up.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate that—just send me the repair drive details and the school times I need to work around.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, I’ll send over the repair drive details and the school times next.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, thanks—once I have them, I’ll line everything up around the school schedule.
